chunks: ʿAbd Allah ibn al-Salt, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Abi Wallad, who said:
I asked Aba ʿAbd Allah عليه السلام about the takbir over the deceased, and he said: five.

key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Aba ʿAbd Allah, Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.التَّكْبِيرِ: the utterance of 'Allahu Akbar' in the funeral prayer
key_terms.الْمَيِّتِ: the deceased person over whom the funeral prayer is performed
key_terms.خَمْسًا: five; the specified number of takbirs

ai.seo_question: How many takbirs are recited over the deceased in funeral prayer according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states the ruling on the number of takbirs to be recited over the deceased. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام answers concisely that they are five, indicating the prescribed number in funeral prayer.
